title: Generative Policy Improvement from Observational Data
abstract: arXiv:2610.23436v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We study how to improve decision policies from observational data to generate better actions when actions are complex, structured objects, such as text messages or images. This task is subject to two major challenges: (i) action-level overlap is often too weak for reliable off-policy evaluation and improvement, and (ii) generating new structured actions often requires expensive training or fine-tuning (e.g., of an LLM) and can be ill-defined due to information loss in action representations. To address both, we propose PolicyLift, a three-stage framework for generative policy improvement with structured actions from observational data. In Stage 1, PolicyLift learns a small set of discrete action codes that capture high-level strategies in the observed action space and are tailored to support policy improvement under limited overlap. translated_title: 从观测数据中进行生成式策略改进
translated_abstract: 我们研究如何从观测数据中改进决策策略，以便在动作是复杂结构化对象（如文本消息或图像）时生成更好的动作。该任务面临两大主要挑战：(i) 动作级别的重叠往往太弱，难以支持可靠的离线策略评估与改进；(ii) 生成新的结构化动作通常需要昂贵的训练或微调（例如对大语言模型），并且由于动作表示中的信息丢失，问题定义可能不明确。为同时解决这两个问题，我们提出了 PolicyLift，一个基于观测数据、面向结构化动作的生成式策略改进三阶段框架。在第一阶段，PolicyLift 学习一小组离散动作码，这些动作码捕捉观测动作空间中的高层策略，并经过专门设计以在有限重叠条件下支持策略改进。在第二阶段，它学习一个基于这些动作码的、依赖上下文的策略。在部署时，第三阶段“提升”（原文截断）……
tldr: 本文提出 PolicyLift，一个三阶段框架，通过学习捕捉高层策略的离散动作码，在动作重叠有限的条件下，从观测数据中实现对文本、图像等结构化动作的生成式策略改进。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes PolicyLift, a three-stage framework that learns discrete action codes capturing high-level strategies, enabling generative policy improvement with structured actions (e.g., text, images) from observational data under limited overlap.
